protocol.allowance_scope: One fixed 4096-attempt limit applied uniformly to every slot of every saved test root before new stress execution; no root-specific limits.
protocol.root_order: Completed original test bank order, retaining all 128 fixed roots.
protocol.root_state_source: test/branches.h5 states[first branch whose root_index equals the saved root index, 0]
protocol.hazard_source: Original familiar layout for each saved root, with centre computed from its disc or box parameters.
protocol.unchanged: Original action primitives and random-draw order, parameter distributions, float32 conversion before arena checks and deduplication, arena bounds and tape uniqueness.
protocol.execution_requirement: The new recovery runner must freeze and verify all 128 complete pools before any stress simulator query; incomplete preflight must stop.

measured_preflight.pool_digest_schema: Repeated UTF-8 root_id, NUL, kind, NUL, C-order float32 tape bytes in saved root order and slot order

historical_reproduction.comparison: Entire ordered trial records, including accepted/rejected outcome, slot, trial, kind, parameters and tape SHA256.

measured_preflight.diagnosis: The original finite rejection allowance failed on arena rejections, not finite primitive-support exhaustion; the unchanged generator completes every fixed root under the uniform larger allowance.

validation.ruff: passed for the new helper and its focused tests
validation.independent_helper_review: No blocking issue reported; caller must bind exact saved initial states and retain preflight failure audits.

evidence_scope.hdf5_data_inspection: Only root_index and the first saved initial state per root were interpreted; full-file hashing reads opaque bytes for identity only.
evidence_scope.interpretation: This validates action-pool construction and provenance only. It does not establish stress-bank execution, safety, repairability, acquisition benefit or any final-performance gate.
evidence_scope.preservation: Original test bank, failed stress bank, frozen sources and their charged interaction costs remain intact; new recovery results require a separate output identity.
